## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] No tokens, secrets, real account names, domains or other people's data in the code, tests, commits or this description.
- [ ] Code, comments and documentation are in English.
- [ ] Behavior or setup changes are reflected in `README.md`, `INSTALL.md` or `.env.example`.
